summary: Verify Nix packages and native checks on a dedicated persistent runner

schema.detail: No database layout or schema-version change. Graph and runtime table, index and trigger declarations commit in groups instead of syncing each declaration separately; a failed declaration rolls back its group.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol or harness contract change. Telemetry test daemons use the existing non-installed fixture executable. Cancelled runs preserve the answer of an already-started final gate instead of cancelling that step during its exit race.

downtime.detail: No installed daemon restart or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: CI operators must provide the dedicated smalltalk-nix-persistent Linux runner with preinstalled Nix, a persistent store and CI_LOCAL_CARGO_HOME for GC roots. Configure free-space policy on the Nix daemon, because untrusted runner accounts cannot override it; retain the untrusted account and place daemon build scratch space on a separate persistent build disk. Dispatch can select an existing release tag without changing that tag or release. Installed users need no additional steps.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
